name: Loving Yourself
overview: Scripture teaches that loving yourself is foundational to loving others, as seen in Leviticus 19:18, where God commands us to love our neighbor as ourselves. This implies a recognition of our own value, which is rooted in God's intimate creation of us, as expressed in Psalms 139:13. Loving yourself also involves seeking wisdom and understanding, which Proverbs 19:8 connects directly to loving one's own soul. Moreover, trusting in God's presence and strength, as Deuteronomy 31:6 encourages, frees believers from fear and envy, enabling a healthy self-regard grounded in God's unfailing care.
